falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,150 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis, proving this is not a comparable accumulation phase

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-level volatility inconsistent with a bottom formation; the August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 38.6 and rapidly mean-revert—persistent elevation would signal a different regime (liquidation/crisis) rather than the expected stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -50 basis points (currently ~-15bps)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion contradicts the bottom_2024_aug pattern which featured rapid steepening from inversion; this would signal accelerating recession pricing rather than the 'soft landing confirmed' narrative that supported the August 2024 recovery, invalidating the macroeconomic foundation of the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
